stories.title: Trump declares victory in Iran talks
stories.description: President Trump says a deal has been reached to end the war with Iran and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. NPR's Franco Ordoñez discusses what we know and what comes next.

stories.title: The U.S. and Iran announce a deal to end the war
stories.description: President Trump said the U.S. would remove its blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: As Iranians wait for a peace agreement, their economy is fraying
stories.description: Many Iranians say they can no longer afford the lives they once had. Writer and historian Arash Azizi talks with NPR's Adrian Florido about the economic pressures reshaping daily life.

stories.title: Britain detains sanctioned oil tanker believed to be linked to Russia's shadow fleet
stories.description: Britain is investigating a sanctioned tanker that is suspected of being part of the Russian "shadow fleet," shipping oil in violation of international sanctions over Moscow's war on Ukraine.

stories.title: Trump condemns Israeli strike in Beirut, warning attacks threaten deal on U.S-Iran war

stories.title: A Lebanon town's grief in the aftermath of a deadly Israeli airstrike
stories.description: More than 3,700 people in Lebanon have died in the war between Israel and Hezbollah. In a village in southern Lebanon, one airstrike last month killed 14 people, including 10 women and children.

stories.title: Trump travels to France for the 52nd G7 Summit

stories.title: Sea drone rescues US army helicopter crew near Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: The uncrewed vessel - which looks similar to a speedboat - rescued the two soldiers from an Apache helicopter that went down on Monday.

stories.title: Trump tells BBC Netanyahu did not defy him

Iran’s World Cup team arrive in United States
stories.description: Iran’s World Cup team touched down on American soil on Sunday, arriving at Los Angeles International Airport after a short flight from their base camp in Mexico. This is the first time in the cup’s nearly 100-year history that a host nation receives a country it is at war with.

stories.title: Trump vows Mideast deal is on, calls for no more attacks
stories.description: US President Donald Trump on Sunday said Israeli strikes on Beirut "should not have happened" as he vowed a regional peace deal was at hand, though he did not confirm his earlier claim it would be signed during the day. France 24's Noga Tarnopolsky tells us more.

stories.description: Iranian chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said on Sunday there was "no point" in continuing peace talks with the United States after its ally Israel attacked Beirut's southern suburbs.
